title: Claude-SpinDynamics: a GPU-accelerated, dual-precision micromagnetic simulator
description: C++20/CUDA micromagnetic simulator with a Python API (LLG/SLLG on structured grids). Single and double precision; cuFFT and VkFFT demag; native SOT/STT/Zhang-Li, DMI, RKKY, magnetoelastic, surface anisotropy; per-cell materials; RK4/RK45-DP/Heun integrators; validated against the uMAG standard problems and cross-checked vs mumax3, mumax+, MuMax-CO. Includes a reproducible cross-solver benchmark suite.
